verdict.rationale: Apple's own spec page gives a concrete memory bandwidth figure for the 16-core CPU / 40-core GPU M4 Max (546GB/s), and the Mac Studio newsroom post repeats it as "over half a terabyte per second of unified memory bandwidth." The evidence also confirms a unified memory architecture, and the claim that it can run LLMs of nearly 200B parameters only hints at the capacity ceiling. Missing for 10: an explicit maximum unified memory capacity for M4 Max, the published memory type/generation (e.g., LPDDR spec), bandwidth figures for the other M4 Max configurations, and independent corroboration of the bandwidth.
